title: Spiral Galaxy NGC 6946
credit: KPNO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/T.A. Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage)/H. Schweiker (WIYN)
displayModel: The photograph's light is decomposed into a midplane residual and a diffuse component spread through 32 slabs with an exponential profile of 449 pc (leroy et al.'s (2008) stellar scale length, 2.5 kpc at their 5.9 Mpc (87.4″), over 7.3, Kregel et al. 2002). Depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Download the publisher Large JPEG; no crop or resample.
